create.name: Bob Stahl
create.bio:
Bob Stahl is an insight meditation and mindfulness teacher whose practice began in a forest monastery in Burma. He ordained there as a Theravada monk in 1980, taking the name U Candima, and spent about eight and a half years in monastic life, with Venerable Hlaing Tet Sayadaw as his main teacher of satipatthana insight meditation. Many of the practices he still teaches, among them the meditation on the thirty-two parts of the body, come from that period. In 1991 he founded Awareness and Relaxation Training, one of the earliest Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction programmes in California, and ran it in hospital settings for three decades.

Today he and Jan Landry offer one-to-one and group mindful mentoring online, and he leads silent retreats for insight centres and mindfulness institutes across North America, Europe and Asia. In Santa Cruz he guides weekly community sits at Insight Santa Cruz. He has written or co-written several books on the MBSR approach, including MBSR Every Day with Elisha Goldstein, and his own site sells guided meditation and gentle mindful yoga recordings and a mindful qigong practice. Many of his retreat talks can be heard free on Dharma Seed.

books.title: MBSR Every Day: Daily Practices from the Heart of Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction
books.author: Elisha Goldstein and Bob Stahl
books.description: A collection of short daily practices drawn from the Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction programme, written with Elisha Goldstein. It is meant to be dipped into, helping readers meet ordinary pressures with steadier, kinder attention to body and mind.

books.title: The Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction Workbook for Anxiety
books.author: Bob Stahl, Florence Meleo-Meyer and Lynn Koerbel
books.description: A workbook of meditations and exercises from the MBSR tradition for people whose days are shaped by worry and fear. Readers learn to notice what sets off anxious states and to stay with everyday situations instead of avoiding them.

courses.title: Online Mindful Mentoring
courses.description: Individual or small-group sessions online with Bob Stahl or Jan Landry, tailored to the person's own mindfulness practice. Sessions can cover starting or renewing a practice, balancing work and life, meeting stress, and living with loss or grief.

courses.title: MBSR Audio Downloads
courses.description: Downloadable guided practices in the MBSR style, including a full body scan and a gentle lying and standing mindful yoga sequence. Each recording is sold on its own.

courses.title: Mindful Qigong video
courses.description: A downloadable video with half an hour of guided mindful qigong followed by half an hour of lovingkindness meditation. The file arrives by email link straight after purchase.

free_resources.title: Bob Stahl's retreat talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: A free archive of recorded dharma talks and guided meditations from retreats he has taught. Talks can be streamed or downloaded.

flags: Health restore: under the new rule his MBSR work is listed; condition-sold items (the Mindful Healing series for blood pressure, heart disease, asthma, insomnia; the MBSR Workbook and Calming the Rush of Panic) are left out, see left_out.

Kept as borderline: MBSR Every Day's publisher blurb says research shows MBSR alleviates health and mental-health conditions including depression; the Workbook for Anxiety calls MBSR an evidence-based treatment model for anxiety. Anxiety is wellbeing wording; the owner may prefer to drop either.
Online Mindful Mentoring's page lists anxiety and insomnia, loss and grief, and living with illness or chronic pain among focus areas, with no cure claim; kept.
His own emails on the contact and mentoring pages are hidden behind a spam-protection script, so the contact form is used.
Base Santa Cruz from Insight Santa Cruz's calendar, where he leads weekly community sits in the centre and online; his own site does not state where he lives.
Possible editorial-stature override: co-author of the widely used MBSR Workbook and founder of one of California's first MBSR programmes; left at local_hero on counts.

Two videos (Body Scan Meditation, Guided Mindfulness Meditation) and Sitting Meditation come from the auto-generated 'Bob Stahl - Topic' channel (his album tracks); others are from Mindful, Brahm Centre and the Gay Buddhist Fellowship, where he is the speaker.
Jan Landry (his co-mentor) is not on Spiritpedia; Bodhi Landry-Stahl's high-school classes are his son's and are not listed.
Living With Your Heart Wide Open left out: no ISBN on a page we may open (New Harbinger's robots.txt disallows all; Hachette UK does not carry it).
Book ISBNs from hachette.co.uk title pages (9781626251731, 9781608829736), not confirmed elsewhere.
left_out: Mindful Healing Audio Downloads page: tracks for high blood pressure ('help stabilize your blood pressure'), heart disease, asthma/COPD and insomnia sit on the same page as the pain tracks (condition claims).
Book: A Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction Workbook (blurb: effective against 'a wide range of medical conditions').

Book: Living With Your Heart Wide Open (no ISBN from a page we may open).
Retreat: Mindfulness Meditation Retreat online with IMS, 4-9 Dec 2026: an Insight Meditation Society programme; its URL is already in the database under Eowyn Ahlstrom (earlier dry run).
All other 2026 retreats on his schedule: started or past by 12 Nov 2026; the 6-13 Nov Spirit Rock retreat is never fetched.
Mindfulness Classes for High School Students: taught by Bodhi Landry-Stahl, not him.
Corporate Program and Alumni Support: business programme and alumni-only.
